thread.title: Special Participation E: Website Visualization Generator
thread.content: <document version="2.0"><paragraph>For my special participation E, I created a step by step setup and prompt that you can follow to have a coding model generate a 3d visual for any deep learning topic you want.</paragraph><paragraph>Here is a pdf explaining exactly how to do it with step-by-step setup instructions and a prompt to enter to the coding llm: </paragraph><file url="https://static.us.edusercontent.com/files/dm0D4HdFRcKOiEDa3zkB3Mve" filename="Special_Participation_E___prompt_for_creating_visuals.pdf"/><paragraph>An example for a visual that codex was able to one shot with this prompt is: <link href="https://svd-visualizer.vercel.app">https://svd-visualizer.vercel.app</link>.</paragraph><paragraph/></document>
thread.document:
